annotations.title: Make a stills template from a frame picture

description: Queues a template made from a PNG of this workspace with transparent windows: each window becomes a photo slot and the PNG is drawn over the photos as the frame. Returns the import id at once; read the result with stills_template_import_get once it is done (the change stream tells you; do not poll). A window that is not a rectangle becomes its bounding box. The PNG must be ready, a PNG, under 15 MB and 40 million pixels. The template stays private to this workspace.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

media_id.description: A PNG in this workspace's library (media_list)

name.description: The template's name, as the picker shows it

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
